A 256-byte table of bottom-left character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D5A writes the selected code one 40-character screen row below the first cell.
A 256-byte table of bottom-right character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D60 writes the selected code one row below and one cell to the right of the first cell.

Load 10 update entry: load X from $4DBD and write $04 to $4DCB,X. It jumps to $0732 when column $6F3C equals $2E; otherwise it jumps to $0200. Before that test, values of $4DB5 at least $05 are set to $04. The entry bytes also belong to the captured character-copy source. The entry was reached during the bounded 200-frame capture and monitor collection. The conditions are tested with controlled inputs; this does not establish a natural route to them.

Load 10 trigger record 1 of 1: initial bytes $FF, $FF, $FF, $FF, $00, $00. $7979 copies the fields to the column, row, remaining-count, argument and callback arrays; the initial callback address is $0000. $48BF compares the stored column and row with the view tile, checks and decrements the count, then dispatches through the callback. Other code can change the stored count.

Load 10 stage object record 1 of 1: initial bytes $05, $08, $01, $02, $14, $17, $4A, $00, $00, $00, $52, $95, $2B, $2C, $2D, $2E. $4655 copies the first 12 fields to per-record arrays and the final four to $7D–$80, then calls $46D6. That map updater can replace those four bytes according to the fourth field and world mode before writing cells. The captured record does not establish that ordinary play reaches its later behavior.

Load 10: the type-$0C vector in the split handler tables at $7EDF/$7F0F selects this entry. Read state $1AB1,X into Y, use the split tables at $9F14/$9F18 to patch the jump at $9F11, and jump to the selected handler. The state index is not locally bounded; only the four captured table entries are described.

Absolute jump whose low and high operands at $9F12/$9F13 are patched from the state tables before execution. The entry snapshot contains placeholder $FF00; controlled dispatch tests reach the four captured targets.
Four captured low bytes of state-handler addresses, paired with high bytes at $9F18. The pairs target $9F1C, $9F40, $9F59, $9F77. The state index has no local bounds check.
Four captured high bytes paired with the low bytes at $9F14. The pairs target $9F1C, $9F40, $9F59, $9F77; their state-handler behavior and ordinary-play reachability remain open.

State 0 calls the event helper at $9FB1; the following describes the path if it returns here. Increment $1AC2,X with eight-bit wrap. If the result is 10, call $3020, mask A with 3, add $17 with carry clear, store the result at $1AD3,X, store one more at $1AE4,X and select state 1. Otherwise return. Arithmetic is binary when decimal mode is clear.
State 1 calls the event helper at $9FB1; if it returns, a negative $1AD3,X selects state 2. Otherwise pass min($1AD3,X, 8) to $4342, decrement $1AD3,X and return.

State 2 calls the event helper at $9FB1; if it returns, increment $1AD3,X with eight-bit wrap. If it equals $1AE4,X, clear $1AC2,X and select state 0. Otherwise pass min($1AD3,X, 8) to $4368 by tail-call. Ordinary-play reachability remains open.

State 3 reads $1AC2,X. A positive value is passed to $4342 and decremented. Zero is replaced by $80; a negative value has bit 7 masked off and is passed to $4368. If the stored value is below $85, increment it; otherwise call $4B0E with A=$20 and jump to $5DB9 with A=3. On the continuing path, load A=3 and use the sign of $9FE0 to jump to $43F0 when negative or $43A2 otherwise. Natural reachability and external callbacks remain open.

Call $792C and $732A. On set carry from $732A, call $72FC and rotate its carry into $9FE0; with carry clear, store 2 plus $19E5,X at $19C3,X, set $1AC2,X=5 and state 3, then pull two stack bytes and return past the calling handler. On clear carry from $732A, call $7227 and return normally if it clears carry, or tail-call $5D7A with A=8 if it sets carry. Arithmetic is binary when decimal mode is clear.
Pull the return address of the JSR that entered this helper off the stack, then RTS to the next return address, skipping the rest of the calling handler.
Working byte rotated right through carry from $72FC by the event helper; state 3 tests its sign to choose a callback.
